> xfree — React 19 + Vite 6 browser tool suite with i18n, CSP enforcement,
>> and production-grade security and testing.
>
> Language: TypeScript
> Focus: developer tools, browser accessibility, security compliance
> Deployed: https://xfree.in
>
> Repo: https://github.com/CodesbyFebin/xfree
> Stack: React 19, TypeScript, Vite 6, Express 4 backend, Vercel hosting
>
> Claims:
> - React 19 + Vite 6 frontend with TypeScript strict mode
> - Express 4 HTTP backend for API routes
> - i18n support across 10 locales with fallback chain
> - Content Security Policy (CSP) headers enforced and validated
> - Search Console regression testing for SEO accuracy
> - Playwright e2e tests in CI
> - CodeQL SAST scanning and Dependabot tracking
> - Verified commit signatures required for production deployment
>
> Verify: AGENTS.md | .github/workflows/ | vite.config.ts | src/server.ts
>
> Status: Production deployment at xfree.in. Next.js alternative (next-app/) is undeployed.
> Limitations: i18n may fall back to English for incomplete translations.
>                CSP blocks inline scripts; all behavior uses modules.
